The platform uses a "Bring Your Own Key" model, which avoids monthly subscriptions by allowing users to connect their own API keys from providers like OpenAI or Anthropic.

The integration of these "System One" decision-making capabilities could allow LLMs to perform internal reasoning, safety checks, and task routing without the latency of external tool-calling. While TypeSafe's advantage may lie in specialized, synthetic training data for calibration, embedding such judgments into general-purpose models presents a significant strategic challenge.
